title.rendered: Reliable Portable Carports: Protect Your Vehicles with Easy-to-Install Shelters

content.rendered:
Want a clean, open-sided carport that shades and protects your vehicles in steel? A portable carport from SAMAN Portable is a custom steel structure, fabricated to order after your enquiry — not a fabric canopy, a plastic cover or a ready-made pop-up carport.

At SAMAN Portable we build carports as engineered steel and MS structures on a clean, new mild-steel frame with steel roofing. Serving India since 2009, incorporated as SAMAN POS India Private Limited in 2019, we fabricate at our own factories in Bengaluru and Greater Noida and supply across India.

A portable carport is an open, roof-led steel shelter that suits homes, factories, sites, farmhouses, villas, parking areas, warehouses, institutions and commercial premises wanting covered parking with open sides for easy access. Each carport is made to order, so size, height and roofing match your vehicles and your space.

Key Takeaways

  • Custom steel / MS carports, fabricated to order
  • Open-sided, roof-led design for easy vehicle access
  • New mild-steel frame with steel roofing for real durability
  • Single-column (cantilever) or multi-column layouts to suit the site
  • Not a fabric, plastic or pop-up product, and not ready stock
  • Direct from the manufacturer, with delivery and installation support

What This Page Covers

This page explains the steel carports SAMAN Portable fabricates to order: what we supply, what we do not, the common sizes and structure options, where carports are used, how customisation works, and the factors that decide your price and delivery. If you want an open steel carport built around your vehicles and site, this is the right starting point.

What SAMAN Supplies

SAMAN Portable manufactures custom steel and MS carports and car sheds on order. Each carport is made-to-order — fabricated after your enquiry, not taken from ready stock.

  • Steel / MS / tubular carports, designed for your size and layout
  • PEB-style framed carports where the span or load needs an engineered design
  • New mild-steel frames with steel roof sheeting, suited to Indian conditions
  • Cantilever and multi-column carports for one or more vehicles
  • Delivery and installation support across India where structurally suitable

What SAMAN Does Not Supply

For clarity, a SAMAN carport is not:

  • Not a fabric, canvas or PVC canopy
  • Not a polyethylene or plastic carport
  • Not a pop-up or fold-up shelter
  • Not a DIY or self-assembly kit
  • Not a ready-made, off-the-shelf stock item

We fabricate engineered steel structures after order — built to stand and last, not a light consumer cover.

Common Custom Sizes and Size Factors

Every carport is made to order, so there is no fixed catalogue size. The right size depends on:

  • Number and type of vehicles to be covered
  • Clear height needed under the roof
  • The footprint and shape of the available area
  • Whether you want a single bay or a multi-bay carport
  • Future plans for extra bays or an extension

Share your plot dimensions and vehicle count, and our team will recommend a workable size and column layout.

Steel / MS Structure and Roofing Options

A SAMAN carport is engineered for strength and clean looks:

  • Structural steel / MS frame, with sections chosen for span and load
  • Cantilever (single-column) or multi-column designs
  • Galvanised or powder-coated finish for corrosion resistance
  • Steel roofing sheets, with insulated panel options where heat matters
  • Flat, sloped or curved roof profiles as required

Structural steel for our framed work is specified to IS 2062, so the frame, columns and roof are matched to the loads of your location.

Applications

Custom steel carports suit a wide range of buyers wherever open covered parking is needed and the site is structurally suitable:

  • Homes, villas and farmhouses needing covered parking with open access
  • Factories and warehouses sheltering vehicles and loading bays
  • Construction and project sites needing quick vehicle cover
  • Offices, institutions and commercial premises managing parking
  • Apartment, society and campus parking where a steel carport is preferred

Customisation

Made-to-order means the carport is shaped around your needs:

  • Overall size, number of bays and clear height
  • Cantilever or multi-column layout to fit existing parking
  • Roof profile and sheeting, including insulated options
  • Open sides, or partial side cladding where wanted
  • Finish and colour to match your premises

To plan your carport, share the size, site location, roofing preference, column or support requirement, and your installation conditions.

Price Factors (No Fixed Price)

Because each carport is fabricated to order, the price is quoted after we understand your requirement. The main factors are:

  • Overall size and number of vehicles covered
  • Steel section and frame design needed for the span and load
  • Type and grade of roof sheeting
  • Clear height of the structure
  • Foundation and site conditions
  • Delivery distance and installation requirements

Tell us your size and location and we will prepare a clear quotation for your specific carport.

Delivery and Installation Factors

A carport installs smoothly when the site is prepared. The main requirements are a level, well-drained base and clear access for delivery and assembly.

  1. Site survey and measurement
  2. Ground levelling and base or foundation preparation
  3. Column and frame erection
  4. Roof sheeting and finishing
  5. Final inspection and handover

Delivery timelines and installation depend on the size, your site conditions and location. Our team advises on the right base and access so the carport stands square and stable.

Why Choose SAMAN Portable

SAMAN Portable is a direct manufacturer of steel sheds and industrial sheds, building from our own factories in Gopasandra, Bengaluru 560099 and Jalpura, Greater Noida 201308. As a factory-direct supplier we control quality from steel to handover, and our framed structures are backed by a clear warranty: 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life.

For more on our steel-shed range, see our guide to industrial sheds. When you are ready, tell us your size, location and vehicles, and we will recommend the right carport for your site.

Get a quote: Call +91 62009 09435 or use the Send Enquiry form, and our team will help you plan your custom steel carport.

Conclusion

A portable carport from SAMAN Portable is a made-to-order steel structure that gives clean, open covered parking — not a fabric canopy or a ready-made kit. Built on a new MS frame with steel roofing and fabricated to your size and site, it serves homes, factories, sites and commercial premises with durable shelter and the backing of a real manufacturer and a real warranty.

FAQ

Is a SAMAN carport a fabric or pop-up canopy?

No. SAMAN carports are engineered steel / MS structures fabricated to order. We do not supply fabric, PVC, plastic or pop-up products, and we do not sell ready-made kits.

What is the difference between a carport and a car shed?

A carport is an open, roof-led steel shelter with open sides for easy access; a car shed can be more covered or partly enclosed. Both are made to order in steel, and we can advise which suits your site.

Is the carport made to order or ready stock?

It is made to order. Each carport is fabricated after your enquiry to suit your size, vehicles and site, so it is not picked from ready stock.

How much does a custom steel carport cost?

There is no single fixed price because every carport is made to order. The cost depends on size, steel section, roof sheet, height, foundation and site condition, and transport. We quote after understanding your requirement.

Can a carport cover more than one vehicle?

Yes. We design single-bay and multi-bay carports. Share how many vehicles you need to cover and your available area, and we will recommend a column layout and size.

What details do you need to plan a carport?

Please share your required size, site location, roofing preference, column or support requirement, and your installation conditions. With these we can recommend a design and prepare a quote.
